en.text:
This weapon passively searches for <link Minor, Elite, or Player [#CombatantClassifications] /> targets within 50 meters and <pve marks them through walls /> <pvp [highlights them] /> for 45 seconds. Requires a minimum of three viable targets and prioritizes the farthest target away. Mark disappears past 80 meters. Cooldown of 7 seconds between marks.

Killing marked targets in any way spawns a 'Telemetry Pattern' at their location for 60 seconds, which can be physically collected to generate 1 ammo.

Telemetry Patterns are lost on death.

Collecting 3 Telemetry Patterns generates 6 ammo and 'Langrangian Sight' for 30 seconds, granting:
• <pve 50% /> <pvp [87.5%] /> increased damage
• 30 Handling
• 35 Reload Speed

Buff can be activated while stowed.

Collecting Telemetry Patterns during Langrangian Sight's timer fully refreshes the buff.
